name: Megaloblastic picture recognised from the indices and the film
rationale: Pancytopenic haemolysis with a high MCV and a poor reticulocyte response; the reviewed film shows megaloblastic nucleated red cells and hypersegmented neutrophils; a diet history and pre-treatment B12 and folate follow. The case must show: MCV 117.4 fL, reticulocytes 44.8 x10^9/L, LDH 3115 U/L, megaloblastic features on the reviewed film, H09 only on a diet question, serum B12 56 pmol/L

name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
rationale: Haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and massive schistocytosis with an intermediate PLASMIC score invite TTP and plasma exchange. The case must show: no fever, no neurological signs, normal creatinine and urine, normal coagulation apart from a slightly raised D-dimer, troponin normal; ADAMTS13 activity (if sent) not severely reduced and reported only after several days

name: Myelodysplastic neoplasm
rationale: Dysplastic nucleated red cells, a hypercellular dysplastic marrow and pancytopenia invite a myelodysplasia label. The case must show: normal karyotype, no excess blasts, no clonal markers; the changes are megaloblastic and reversible

name: Cancer-related microangiopathic haemolysis
rationale: Weight loss, anorexia and a microangiopathic picture in an adult raise disseminated cancer; the authors did the marrow to exclude it. The case must show: no lymphadenopathy or organomegaly, marrow without infiltrate, normal imaging and tumour markers

name: Disseminated intravascular coagulation or sepsis
rationale: Schistocytes, thrombocytopenia and a raised D-dimer. The case must show: afebrile, CRP and procalcitonin normal, cultures negative, fibrinogen and PT normal

name: Immune haemolysis, PNH or connective tissue disease
rationale: Haemolysis with cytopenias. The case must show: DAT and antibody screen negative, no PNH clone, no haemoglobinuria, autoantibodies and complement normal

name: Cause of the deficiency: pernicious anaemia or malabsorption
rationale: Once B12 is low, a careful player looks for the cause. The case must show: diet the only cause found; intrinsic factor and parietal cell antibodies negative; no gastric or ileal surgery; no metformin or acid suppression; coeliac serology, thyroid and endoscopy normal; no fish tapeworm

name: Folate deficiency or alcohol
rationale: Macrocytosis with a megaloblastic marrow; folate deficiency and alcohol are the common alternatives. The case must show: folate normal, little alcohol, GGT normal

name: Neurological involvement
rationale: B12 deficiency can damage the dorsal columns, nerves and optic nerves. The case must show: no symptoms or signs; imaging and nerve studies normal if requested

name: Infection or travel-related haemolysis
rationale: Haemolysis and cytopenias in a young adult; in an Indian setting a player tests for malaria, dengue and viruses. The case must show: no travel, no fever; malaria, dengue and viral tests negative

name: Hypertensive or renal thrombotic microangiopathy
rationale: Schistocytes with thrombocytopenia call for the blood pressure, fundi, urine and kidneys. The case must show: normal blood pressure and fundi, bland urine, normal creatinine and kidneys
